# demo-vid-mcp — full reference

## Architecture

demo-vid-mcp orchestrates fleet services to produce repo intro videos. Pipeline stages:
- Script parsing (YAML narration)
- Playwright recording (.webm)
- voiceover via speech-mcp TTS (.wav)
- Composition via FFmpeg (.mp4)
- Optional: blender-mcp 3D titles, gimp-mcp art, davinci-resolve-mcp composition

## Tools

### demo_vid_generate(repo, script_yaml?)
Full pipeline: validate script, voiceover, record, compose.

### demo_vid_list(repo?)
List produced videos. Filters by repo when given.

### demo_vid_refine(video_name, feedback)
Re-generate with timing/narration adjustments.

### demo_vid_script_draft(repo)
Draft default narration YAML for a repo.

### demo_vid_script_validate(script_yaml)
Validate narration script structure.

## Configuration

See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

## Fleet Services

| Service | URL env var | Fallback |
|---------|-------------|----------|
| speech-mcp | SPEECH_MCP_URL | Required — no fallback |
| blender-mcp | BLENDER_MCP_URL | gimp-mcp → plain text |
| gimp-mcp | GIMP_MCP_URL | plain text title |
| davinci-resolve-mcp | DAVINCI_RESOLVE_MCP_URL | FFmpeg composition |
| vfx-mcp | VFX_MCP_URL | No effects |
| stems-mcp | STEMS_MCP_URL | No music |
| sfx-mcp | SFX_MCP_URL | No sound effects |

## Ports

11134 (backend), 11135 (frontend).
